title: Caltech Mathathon – first hackathon ever devoted to research level mathematics
summary: Caltech Mathathon is the first hackathon ever devoted to research-level mathematics, bringing hackathon culture to pure mathematical research and creating a unique collaborative platform for mathematicians to tackle advanced theoretical problems in a time-boxed competitive format.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between hackathon culture and theoretical mathematics research, making advanced math collaboration more accessible and time-efficient.
why_valuable: Creates a novel intersection of competitive programming culture with deep mathematical research, potentially accelerating breakthroughs by fostering intense collaboration among mathematicians.
